finalText:
Build is clean. The error was in `src/core/settings.js` — line 17 tried to use an undefined `retries` variable instead of pulling it from `env.retries`. Fixed it by adding `retries: 3` to DEFAULTS and changing the line to `maxRetries: env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries`.

The three warnings (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) are still there as expected — they're harmless notices, not failures. Build now finishes with 0 errors.
